Best Salads In Manchester

Published 05 March 2025. By Katie Kirwan.

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:06
Instaread

Manchester is home to such a wonderfully vibrant food scene, offering everything from sourdough pizzas to indulgent Indian curries. There are just some days, however, when you really crave a wholesome salad. Salad has come a long way since the days of limp lettuce and soggy packed lunches. Instead of boring combinations, there are now bowls upon bowls of protein, vibrant veggies, unusual superfoods, and delicious dressings. Whether you prefer the classic Caesar or something more adventurous like a Buddha bowl or Vietnamese papaya salad, there are plenty of places in Manchester for salad where you can get your fix.

Manchester's best places for salad

Evelyn’s

  • Cafe, Bar, Plant-based
  • 44 Tib St, Manchester M4 1LA, UK
Northern Quarter cafe, Evelyn’s offers a fresh and healthy take on dining out, with strong plant-based options and a focus on clean eating. Salads take pride of place on the menu, with everything from a nourishing House Salad (featuring braised tofu, green beans, red cabbage, soft boiled eggs, cucumber, mint, lime and a peanut chilli dressing) and tuna-packed poke bowls and a crowd-favourite chicken Caeser salad, served in big bowls that will keep you full all day long. The leafy venue takes inspiration from Asia and the Middle East for a lot of its dishes, with the likes of za'atar lamb chops and teriyaki oyster mushrooms available too. To complement the clean-eating vibe, Evelyn’s also offers in-house cold-pressed juices, coffees and matcha lattes alongside cocktails and other alcoholic drinks.
 

The Laundrette

  • Burger, Pizza, Vegan / Vegetarian Friendly
  • 32 Beech Road, Manchester, Greater Manchester, United Kingdom, M21 9EL
Nestled in the heart of Chorlton, The Laundrette is a quirky bar and restaurant with a relaxed atmosphere and a menu that mirrors the steps in the laundry cycle. While a food offering that revolves around cocktails and carbs might not be your first port of call for a healthy plate of veggies, there’s a section – Easy Care – dedicated to fresh salads, which can be enjoyed on the south-facing sun terrace. Choose from a classic Caesar or the more adventurous Crunchy Thai Veg Salad, or there’s even a goats cheese and pear salad for those who fancy something extra vibrant. Pair it with a unique cocktail such as the Bubble Bath, which is complete with white chocolate foam and served in a plastic bathtub.
 

HOME

  • British, Cafe, Brunch
  • 2 Tony Wilson Place, First St, Manchester, United Kingdom, M15 4FN
The independent darling of Manchester’s cultural scene, HOME is an independent cinema, theatre, art gallery, bar and restaurant located on First Street. On the light and airy first floor, the main restaurant is an institution in its own right. If you fancy something a bit lighter for your pre-theatre dinner, there’s a selection of salads bowls, taking inspiration from around the globe. Whether you go for the North African Buddha Bowl, the Superfood Salad or the Avocado Super Poke, all can be spruced up with an added protein of your choice - think teriyaki salmon, grilled haloumi chargrilled steak and more.
